name: Securities Tax
definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters such as thresholds or income.

TaxableIncomePerShare.name: Taxable Income Per Share
TaxableIncomePerShare.definition: Amount included in the NAV that corresponds to gains directly or indirectly derived from interest payment in the scope of the European Directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments.

TaxableIncomePerShareCalculated.name: Taxable Income Per Share Calculated
TaxableIncomePerShareCalculated.definition: Specifies whether the fund calculates a taxable interest per share (TIS).

EUCapitalGain.name: EU Capital Gain
EUCapitalGain.definition: Specifies whether capital gain is in the scope of the European directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments (Council Directive 2003/48/EC 3 June), or an income realised upon sale, a refund or redemption of shares and units, etc.

EUDividendStatus.name: EU Dividend Status
EUDividendStatus.definition: Specifies whether dividend is in the scope of the European directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments (Council Directive 2003/48/EC 3 June), or an income realised upon sale, a refund or redemption of shares and units, etc.

TaxableIncomePerDividend.name: Taxable Income Per Dividend
TaxableIncomePerDividend.definition: Amount included in the dividend that corresponds to gains directly or indirectly derived from interest payment in the scope of the European Directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments.

StampDutyType.name: Stamp Duty Type
StampDutyType.definition: Indicates how the stamp duty should be applied.

StampDutyTaxBasis.name: Stamp Duty Tax Basis
StampDutyTaxBasis.definition: Specifies the stamp duty type or exemption reason applicable to the settlement transaction.

TaxableIncomePerDividendShare.name: Taxable Income Per Dividend Share
TaxableIncomePerDividendShare.definition: Amount included in the dividend/NAV that is identified as gains directly or indirectly derived from interest payments within the scope of the EU Savings directive

TaxLotNumber.name: Tax Lot Number
TaxLotNumber.definition: Identification, for tax purposes, of a lot of identical securities that are bought at a certain date and at a certain price.

TaxRuleExemptIndicator.name: Tax Rule Exempt Indicator
TaxRuleExemptIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the tax rule applies within the jurisdiction as a condition of this security.

EffectivePeriod.name: Effective Period
EffectivePeriod.definition: Period during which the tax rule applies within the jurisdiction.

FrankedRate.name: Franked Rate
FrankedRate.definition: Percentage of dividend for which tax is already paid.

TEFRARule.name: TEFRA Rule
TEFRARule.definition: Indicates the TEFRA rule under which the security is issued.

TaxVoucher.name: Tax Voucher
TaxVoucher.definition: Tax voucher which is related to a securities tax.

RelatedTax.name: Related Tax
RelatedTax.definition: Percentage of the gross dividend rate on which tax must be paid .

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Security on which the tax applies.

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Jurisdiction in which the tax rule applies.
